div.head: I Em Inscr.
div.ab: (Hier beginnt D) König Eadmunds Verordnung (Satzung H).
(Here begins, D) King Edmund's ordinance (statute, H).
div.note: Base text K = H (Textus Roffensis f. 44, c. 1125, after II Ew). Also in D (CCCC 201 p. 96), B (CCCC 383 f. 78), G (Cotton Nero A I f. 88v, breaks off in the Prologue), Ld and Quadr. Heading in red in H, D and G.; AY: added from Rabin p. 346, October 2026 (Rabin’s note to the text); F: corrected against Liebermann, Gesetze I (date in the running heads); Wormald, Making of English Law I, October 2026 (was “Easter; Apr. 942–Mar. 946; 942 or 944–6 (Robertson); London”, now “Apr. 942–Mar. 946 (Liebermann); 942 or 944–6 (Robertson); Easter 945 or 946 (Wormald); London”); F: corrected against Liebermann, Gesetze I (date at the head of the text); Wormald, Making of English Law I; Whitelock, English Historical Documents I, October 2026 (was “Apr. 942–Mar. 946 (Liebermann); 942 or 944–6 (Robertson); Easter 945 or 946 (Wormald); London”, now “Apr. 942–Mar. 946 (Liebermann, I p. 184); 942 or 944–6 (Robertson); Easter 945 or 946 (Wormald, MEL p. 441); London”); BQ: page of each of Liebermann’s texts and of his German, checked against Liebermann, Gesetze I (our double-read transcription), October 2026 (e.g. was “(empty)”, now “D 184; H 184; G 184; German 185”; 8 rows of I Em); V: page of the modern editor’s text / translation, checked against Robertson (translation on the facing page), October 2026 (e.g. was “6”, now “6 / 7”; 8 rows of I Em); AX: pages in Rabin (text / translation), checked against Rabin (our double-read transcription), October 2026 (e.g. was “346”, now “346 / 347”; 2 rows of I Em)

Manuscripts: B = Cambridge, Corpus Christi College MS 383, fols. 54v–55r; D = Cambridge, Corpus Christi College MS 201, pp. 96–97; G = London, British Library, Cotton MS Nero A.i, fol. 87v; H = Strood, Medway Archive and Local Studies Centre MS DRc/R1 (Textus Roffensis), fols. 44r–45r.
Her . . . gerædnes: Eadmundes cyninges asetnysse H; Eadmundes gerædnes G; omitted B

note.seg: H. o. E. g. in red
Die Überschrift in dg weicht von der in H ab; jede ist also wahrscheinlich erst von den zwei Sammlern eingeführt. Asetnys in H ist jünger als gerædnes in dg
The heading in dg differs from that in H; each was therefore probably introduced only by the two compilers. Asetnys in H is later than gerædnes in dg
